description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. A synthetic PCIe-endpoint-shaped configuration space written for dv_harness_tests/test_config_variant_coverage.py. It is NOT any real DUT's configuration space, NOT read from any project manifest, and must never be cited as evidence about a real device. Its dimensions are the ones spec section 232 names (protocol generation, speed, lane width, data width, compile defines, feature modes, SKU, clock mode) so the fixture exercises a realistically SHAPED space, not a toy one.
